import sys

def main():
    # Read input
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    n = int(line)
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    maxSegment = 0
    underCount = 0
    lastBoundary = -1
    inside = False
    
    for index in range(len(s)):
        c = s[index]
        if c == '_':
            if lastBoundary != index - 1:
                if inside:
                    underCount += 1
                else:
                    maxSegment = max(maxSegment, index - 1 - lastBoundary)
            lastBoundary = index
        elif c == '(':
            inside = True
            if lastBoundary != index - 1:
                maxSegment = max(maxSegment, index - 1 - lastBoundary)
            lastBoundary = index
        elif c == ')':
            inside = False
            if lastBoundary != index - 1:
                underCount += 1
            lastBoundary = index
    
    if lastBoundary != len(s) - 1:
        maxSegment = max(maxSegment, len(s) - 1 - lastBoundary)
    
    print(f"{maxSegment} {underCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
